evidence.citation: Artifact: "Run another 1–2 blind trials—each with a fresh, context-free runner ... followed by a separate judge ... Sweep the live checkout after every run" and, for any justified edit, "rerun all golden cases ... repeat important or borderline cases 2–3 times, and report per-case before/after pass rates."
evidence.criterion: C1: The artifact does not require materially unnecessary execution work under the supplied cost evaluation bar.

rationale: The additional runs, independent judging, checkout sweeps, and full-case reruns are reproducibility, integrity, and regression-validation controls tied to diagnosing the 1/1 rerun and verifying any edit. Under the supplied bar, that execution work is necessary rather than materially unnecessary.
